Camarines Sur under red alert as LPA nears

READ | Camarines Sur has been placed under red alert as a low-pressure area (LPA) threatens to bring heavy rainfall and possible flooding.

Governor Luis Raymund “Lray” Villafuerte announced that the heightened alert took effect at 5 a.m. Monday, following the directive of the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (PDRRMC) as part of preemptive safety measures.

“With the declaration of red alert, all local DRRM councils and response agencies are directed to activate their emergency protocols and operate on a 24/7 basis,” Villafuerte said in a statement. | Rex Espiritu

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI

ThreadFi Daily

Bitcoin Whale Drama Unfolds 

A massive whale dumped 24 000 Bitcoin worth over $2.7 billion, triggering a brief flash crash below $110 000. 
But here is the amazing part! the market bounced back like a champion, showing just how resilient crypto has become.

Willy Woo (@willywoo) says These early holders who bought BTC under $10 and they are selling into today’s market thus forcing $110K of new capital for each Bitcoin absorbed. 

Ethereum Makes History Again! 

ETH just smashed through $4 900 for the first time ever! marking its highest price since 2021. 
This isn’t just another pump it’s a statement that Ethereum is ready for the next chapter with analysts now eyeing that magical $5 000 level.

MAJOR TECH & INVESTMENTS MOVES

Nuclear Power Meets Bitcoin 

@ConstellationEG Energy is investing billions in nuclear power expansion, with plans to restart facilities generating clean energy for Bitcoin mining.

Wormhole Challenges LayerZero for Stargate

@Wormhole has entered a bidding war for @Stargate, planning to outbid @LayerZero’s $110M offer, which already secured strong STG holder approval. Wormhole claims Stargate is undervalued and asked for a 5 day vote delay. 
Both $W and $STG tokens briefly spiked on the news. 
Final control rests with veSTG holders though only 10% have voted so far.

Starknet Welcomes Bitcoin Staking

@Starknet has approved SNIP-31 thus enabling Bitcoin staking on its Ethereum Layer 2. Wrapped BTC will carry 25% staking weight, with STRK maintaining majority control. 
New governance rules allow future BTC wrappers and the upgrade will go live in coming weeks. 
Users will soon stake wBTC to earn network rewards.

Windtree Delisted After Collapse

Windtree Therapeutics has been delisted from Nasdaq after failing to meet the $1 minimum bid rule. 
Its stock (WINT) plunged 99% in 2025, from $17 to $0.11 despite a pivot into BNB treasury management. 
Meanwhile, BNB hit a new all time high of $881 before easing to $851 showing resilience despite Windtree’s collapse.

Philippines Bets Big on Bitcoin Reserves

The Philippines has proposed the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Act, directing its central bank to buy 2000 BTC annually for five years, building a 10 000 Bitcoin reserve locked in cold storage for 20 years. 
Sales are restricted to paying down national debt, aiming to diversify assets beyond gold and dollars and boost financial resilience.

MARKET  PULSE 

Fear and Greed Index: 47 (Fear)
Global Market Cap: $4 T

SUMMARY 

The crypto market rewards patience and smart positioning. 
While others panic during dips, successful investors see opportunities. Those 100%+ gains don’t happen by accident ,they happen to projects building real utility and value.
Remember, we are not just watching price movements. We are witnessing the birth of a new financial system.

Disclaimer: This content is for educational purposes only. Always do your own research (DYOR)
